title: Hearty Homemade Italian Tomatoes Cacio E Pepe
description: A dairy-free friendly Italian dish featuring tinned tomatoes and a cheesy pull, perfect for midnight cravings. This jammy and satisfying meal is a twist on the classic cacio e pepe.
instructions: Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil and cook the spaghetti according to package instructions.
In a large skillet, heat the olive oil over medium heat and saute the minced garlic until fragrant.
Add the crushed tinned tomatoes to the skillet and stir to combine with the garlic and oil.
Reduce heat to low and let the tomato mixture simmer for 10 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Stir in the shredded vegan parmesan cheese and let it melt into the tomato sauce.
Add the cooked spaghetti to the skillet, tossing to combine with the tomato sauce and cheese.
Season with salt and black pepper to taste.
Serve hot, garnished with additional nutritional yeast if desired.
Let the dish rest for a few minutes before serving to allow the flavors to meld together.
